World-Class Dorado Fishing at Puerto Los Cabos Marina

Discover dorado fishing in Cabo with Exotic Fish Cabo and experience one of the most colorful and exciting sportfish found in Los Cabos.

Also known as mahi-mahi, dorado are famous for their brilliant colors, powerful strikes, and spectacular jumps.

Our private fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, giving anglers access to productive waters in the Sea of Cortez.

Depending on seasonal conditions, our experienced local captains search for dorado around floating debris, current lines, and offshore feeding areas.

Enjoy a personalized Cabo fishing adventure with private 6-hour and 8-hour charter options.

Why Dorado Fishing in Cabo is Unreal

  • Spectacular Colors: Dorado are famous for their brilliant blue, green, and golden coloration.

  • Exciting Fights: Powerful strikes, fast runs, and acrobatic jumps make mahi-mahi a favorite among sportfishing enthusiasts.

  • Seasonal Opportunities: Warmer waters around Los Cabos can provide favorable conditions for dorado fishing.

  • Excellent Eating Quality: Dorado are prized for their firm, mild-flavored white meat.

  • Suitable for Different Experience Levels: Dorado fishing can be enjoyable for both beginners and experienced anglers, depending on ocean conditions.

Best Time for Dorado Fishing in Los Cabos

The dorado season in Cabo runs year-round with peak action from May through November. Here's what to expect:

Dorado Fishing Calendar

Dorado fishing opportunities are available throughout the year in Los Cabos, although activity varies significantly with water temperature, currents, and baitfish availability.

The warmer months, particularly summer and fall, often provide favorable conditions for mahi-mahi fishing around San José del Cabo. Dorado may also be encountered outside these periods when ocean conditions are suitable.

These fast-growing predators frequently gather near floating debris, drifting vegetation, current boundaries, and concentrations of baitfish.

The number and size of dorado cannot be reliably predicted by month alone. Actual fishing opportunities depend on daily ocean conditions and seasonal movements.

For a month-by-month overview of fishing opportunities in Los Cabos, visit our Cabo Fishing Calendar.

The Exotic Fish Cabo Dorado Experience

Target Species: Dorado (Mahi Mahi / Dolphin Fish)

When you book a dorado charter in San Jose del Cabo, you're targeting one of the most exciting gamefish in the ocean:

  • Bull Dorado: Males with distinctive blunt heads, often larger and more aggressive

  • Cow Dorado: Females with rounded heads, known for their incredible fight

  • Chicken Dorado: Smaller juveniles perfect for light tackle and family fun

Where We Find Dorado

Our private dorado fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, providing access to offshore fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez.

Depending on weather conditions, currents, and recent fish activity, fishing areas may include Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, and other suitable offshore locations.

Dorado are highly mobile predators that often follow schools of smaller fish. They can also gather near floating debris, drifting vegetation, and current boundaries where food becomes concentrated.

Our experienced local crews select fishing locations and techniques according to the conditions encountered during each trip.

Specific fishing areas and catches cannot be guaranteed.

Techniques We Use

Our crews adapt tactics based on conditions to maximize your dorado catch:

  • Trolling with Lures: Bright feathers, squid chains, and skirted lures in green, yellow, and pink

  • Live Bait: Sardines and mackerel when dorado are keyed on specific prey

  • Casting to Structure: Pitching baits to floating debris where dorado school up

  • Additional Fishing Techniques: Depending on the selected boat, available equipment, and fishing conditions, crews may use different lure presentations or other techniques to attract dorado.

  • Light Tackle: 20-30 lb test for maximum sport and thrilling fights

What's Included in Your Dorado Charter

  • Every private dorado fishing charter with Exotic Fish Cabo includes:

    • Private fishing boat with an experienced local crew

    • Fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle

    • Bottled water and soft drinks

    • Fishing techniques adapted to seasonal conditions and target species

    • A private fishing experience tailored to your group

    Fishing licenses, live bait, meals, transportation, fish-cleaning services, and any additional fees should be confirmed before booking.

Dorado Fishing Tips for Success

  1. Keep the Fight Going: Dorado are curious—fighting one fish slowly often brings the whole school to the boat for multiple hook-ups

  2. Watch for Birds: Frigatebirds and gulls diving indicate baitfish—and where there's bait, there are dorado

  3. Bring Polarized Sunglasses: Spotting dorado near the surface before they see you is a game-changer

  4. Be Ready to Cast: When the captain spots debris or breaking fish, seconds count

  5. Book Morning Trips: Dorado feed aggressively at first light; early departures often produce the best action

From Ocean to Table – Fresh Dorado Dining

There's nothing quite like enjoying fresh mahi-mahi you've caught yourself. Dorado is prized for its firm, white flesh and mild, sweet flavor.

If you choose to keep your catch within Mexican sportfishing regulations, our team can explain available fish-cleaning options and suggest local restaurants that may prepare your fish.

Please confirm available services and any additional fees before your trip.

Why Choose Exotic Fish Cabo for Dorado Fishing?

    • Convenient Departure: All fishing trips depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

    • Private Charters Only: Your selected boat is reserved exclusively for your group.

    • Local Fishing Knowledge: Experienced crews adapt fishing locations and techniques to seasonal conditions.

    • Flexible Trip Options: Choose between private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters.

    • Different Boat Options: Select a boat according to your group size, fishing preferences, and desired amenities.

    • Beginners Welcome: Our team can help first-time anglers and families prepare for their fishing adventure.

Book Your Dorado Charter in San Jose del Cabo

Ready to experience dorado fishing in Cabo?

Exotic Fish Cabo offers private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Whether you're hoping to encounter your first mahi-mahi or planning another offshore fishing adventure, our experienced local crews can help you explore seasonal fishing opportunities in the Sea of Cortez.

Browse our private fishing charter options or contact us to check availability, prices, and the best boat for your group.
